issue.description:
README.md and AGENTS.md reference concrete repo artifacts — docs/img/bead-lifecycle.gif and docs/img/bead-lifecycle-static.png (the six-stage lifecycle animation and its reduced-motion storyboard), BUILD_PROCEDURE.md, docs/build-attempt-resolution-binary.md, scripts/build-from-archive.sh, docs/adr/*.md, and research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md — but nothing in the supplied tests or beads verifies those targets exist. issue.description:
Auto-split child 2/4 of beadrs-5d781dc7, depends on the checkout-context classifier.

Scope: the SharedState snapshot in tests/build_from_archive_checkout_untouched.rs must not run git probes in an exported-tree context. `git rev-parse HEAD` there is the exact panic that failed beadrs-5d781dc7 three times -- a git-archive extraction has no .git.

- In real-checkout context, snapshot all five surfaces: HEAD, index, worktree, reflog, stash.
- In exported-tree context, derive the baseline without any git invocation (recorded archive SHA / non-VCS baseline), so no probe can panic.
- No unwrap/expect on git output anywhere on the archive path.

Acceptance:
- The test binary reaches its assertions inside a `git archive HEAD` extraction with no .git anywhere up the tree, without panicking on HEAD discovery.
- The real-checkout path still snapshots all five surfaces.
issue.title: Gate VCS snapshot probes on checkout context
